project_metadata.name: LexDraft AI (Case Evidence Organizer)
project_metadata.domain: Applied Legal AI / Multi-Modal Evidence Processing / Indian Evidence Admissibility
project_metadata.target_users: Litigation Advocates, Arbitrators, Corporate Legal Chambers (India)

executive_architecture_summary.pattern: Polyglot Microservices + Edge Streaming Gateway + Monolithic Legal Core

primary_gateways.web_and_auth: Ruby WEBrick / Rack on Port 8080 (serves Vanilla SPA + REST API)
primary_gateways.edge_stream_ingestion: Node.js Express + Multer on Port 8080/3000 (streaming up to 4GB files)
primary_gateways.ai_inference_engine: Python FastAPI + Uvicorn on Port 8000 (ASR + Multi-Model Orchestration)

key_statutory_differentiators: Section 65B Indian Evidence Act 1872 & Section 63 Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 certificate generator
Statutory 3-year commercial dispute limitation clock (Limitation Act 1963)
Zero-tolerance deterministic reverse token grounding (anti-hallucination verification)
Multi-model consensus voting engine (Gemini Flash, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
Cryptographic SHA-256 deduplication cache with 0ms replay and token metering

layer_1_presentation.name: Presentation & Interaction Layer
layer_1_presentation.runtime: Browser DOM (zero-build requirement for public/ track)
responsibilities: Render SPA views: Landing Page, Auth Modal, Chamber Dashboard, Case Ingestion, Evidence Grid, Chronology Timeline, Diff Inspector, Export Suite
Optimistic UI rendering for instant sub-10ms view switching
HTML5 audio/video playback with microsecond click-to-seek timestamp binding (`currentTime`)
Server-Sent Events (SSE) consumer for real-time document extraction progress bars
Session authentication via Authorization: Bearer <token> stored in localStorage

layer_2_edge_gateway.name: Edge Streaming Ingestion Gateway
responsibilities: Stream large multipart form uploads (up to 4GB) without buffer exhaustion
Reverse proxy uploads directly to Python AI processor (`/api/v1/ingest`)
Provide fallback Server-Sent Events progress reporting (`/api/progress/:evidenceId`)
Serve static assets from public/ directory

layer_3_core_application.name: Core Legal Application & Persistence Engine
responsibilities: Monolithic REST API controller for case management, evidence indexing, and summary delivery
Per-user data isolation and chamber partitioning via foreign-key scoped queries
Statutory compliance generation (Section 65B / Section 63 BSA cryptographic affidavits)
Master summary aggregation, narrative synthesis, and chronology diff log generation
High-performance static file serving with smart Cache-Control headers and disabled DNS reverse lookup

layer_4_ai_processor.name: Multi-Model AI & Verification Engine
responsibilities: Audio/Video Speech-to-Text ASR with speaker diarization and timestamp generation before LLM ingestion
Tier 1 extraction via Google Gemini 2.0 Flash with Cascading Early-Exit Gate (confidence >= 0.90)
Tier 2 adversarial fan-out to OpenAI GPT-4o and Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet on high complexity/dispute
Mathematical consensus collation without secondary LLM arbitration
Zero-tolerance reverse token grounding scanner against raw source text

stage_1_asr_pre_processing.trigger: File type is AUDIO or VIDEO
stage_1_asr_pre_processing.rationale: Audio/video cannot be reliably passed to text-based extraction without high-fidelity speaker diarization and microsecond timestamping.
stage_1_asr_pre_processing.output: Diarized dialogue turns with speaker labels and start/end time markers bound to HTML5 seek events.

stage_2_tier_1_gemini_extraction.purpose: High-speed OCR, multimodal layout parsing, and initial fact extraction.

cascading_early_exit.condition: Confidence >= 0.90 AND Complexity != 'Hard' AND Disputed == false
cascading_early_exit.action: Return Tier-1 extraction immediately, bypassing Tier-2 models.

stage_3_tier_2_adversarial_fanout.engine: OpenAI GPT-4o + Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet (concurrent via asyncio.gather)
stage_3_tier_2_adversarial_fanout.trigger: Confidence < 0.90 OR pecuniary figure conflict OR illegible seal/signature
stage_3_tier_2_adversarial_fanout.purpose: Extract conflicting clauses, counter-arguments, and hidden admissions.

stage_4_mathematical_collation.mechanism: Strict deterministic consensus algorithm; normalization of currencies to float and dates to ISO-8601.
stage_4_mathematical_collation.anti_hallucination_rule: NO secondary LLM is ever used to arbitrate disagreements. Conflicts are flagged for human advocate review.

stage_5_reverse_token_grounding.mechanism: Regex and substring scan asserting every monetary amount, date, and clause number in the output exists verbatim in the raw source document.

ui_indicators.grounded: 🟢 Grounded (All extracted tokens matched against source file)
ui_indicators.drift: 🔴 Unverified Token Drift (Pecuniary or date discrepancy flagged)
